items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: No, they had a clarinet. Handy.

ctx.x: Which Barnes? Frank Warp player. Jules. Jules Barnes. Charlie Moore.
Which instrument did he play then? Banjo or guitar or what? He played banjo. Banjo at that time. Mm-hmm. Have a clarinet player? Saxophone player? No, they had a clarinet. Handy. Yeah.

A handy from downtown. John Handy, sure. John Handy, sure. John Handy, yeah. I must have had a bass player or a piano player. Yeah, they had a bass player, I just remember. Jake. Jake, huh? Yeah, probably they called Jake. Mm-hmm.
